description: Canonical joint-chargeability fixture table. A credit is consumed only when BOTH the mechanics score and the benchmark range are independently validated AND durably delivered once, bound to an unconsumed ledger credit. Mobile, Edge and SQL tests consume this table; the expected verdicts are declared by hand, never derived from an implementation.

cases.description: Real outcome with a validated mechanics score AND a validated benchmark range, durably published once, bound to an unconsumed credit under an eligible release: the only shape that consumes a credit.
Mechanics validated but the benchmark was withheld for insufficient evidence; publication and ledger are otherwise perfect.
Mechanics validated but the benchmark validation was not approved.
Benchmark validated but the mechanics score was withheld.
One output withheld but the producer stamped status=complete with the chargeable disposition: the outcome fails validation, it never becomes chargeable.
A partial outcome carrying billingDisposition=joint_verification_required is invalid.
Both outputs validated but delivery failed before durable publication: nothing was delivered, nothing is charged.
The pipeline produced no numerical output at all and nothing was published.
A corrupt/truncated outcome record is unknown state, never a completed charge.
An outcome from an unknown schema version is not interpreted.
Synthetic (fixture) input can never carry chargeable numerical outputs.
No independently verified eligibility was supplied (null): fail closed.
Eligibility that does not come from the release authority + owner ledger is untrusted.
A malformed eligibility record (unknown extra field) is rejected rather than read leniently.
The outcome claims durable publication but the owner ledger could not verify that both outputs were durably published exactly once.
The release authority could not be verified: numerical outputs are withheld.
No release approval exists for these outputs.
The release approval was withdrawn.
The release approval expired.
The observed input is outside the released domain.
The authority reports the produced lineage does not match the released lineage.
The mechanics output came from a model that is not the released one.
Mechanics and benchmark were produced by different pipeline versions: they are not one joint result.
The benchmark output came from a calibration that is not the released one.
The benchmark interval does not sit on the approved 0.5 boundaries.
The benchmark interval is wider than the approved maximum width.
The benchmark interval lies outside every supported interval.
The benchmark's nominal coverage differs from the approved uncertainty contract.
An abstained result (both outputs withheld) that was durably published is delivered but not chargeable.
The owner ledger already consumed the credit for this publication: a replay charges nothing.
The same outputs re-presented under a different operation id are not the verified operation (never retry under a new operation id).
The ledger verified a different publication id than the outcome carries.
The outcome is bound to a different owner than the verified ledger row (cross-account isolation).
The outputs were produced for a different capture / input hash than the verified one.
The verified ledger row belongs to another analysis id.
